A very good restaurant in Phan Tiet…definitely worth a visit
Feb 2026 • Couples
We really enjoy this restaurant, last year we went twice in four days. This year we have been three times in five days!

The staff and owners are wonderful and extremely friendly and helpful. 

The food was exceptional! This year we both enjoyed the steak on a hot stone, I had Strip loin and my husband had fillet. We enjoyed it so much we had it on two occasions. I have also ordered the chicken, half a chicken is a good size for one person. The white chocolate cream desert is gorgeous. It’s their take on crème brûlée and it certainly doesn’t disappoint. The wine selection is ok and very reasonably priced.

We will go back to Modjo when we are next in Phan Tiet!
